fields.v: Proposes an approach; secondary: Compares — Spec Kit Agents (multi-agent Spec Kit pipeline with PM/developer roles and context-grounding discovery and validation hooks), evaluated against Baseline, Augmented and Full (GitHub Spec Kit) plus Discovery-only and Validation-only ablations on 32 feature tasks (5 repositories) and SWE-bench Lite
fields.quote: We present Spec Kit Agents a multi-agent SDD pipeline (with PM and developer roles) that adds phase-level, context-grounding hooks.
fields.why: The main contribution is the authors' own system, so under the 2026-11-23 rule the main nature is 'Proposes an approach' (consistent with Q13 being scored), not 'Evaluates'.
fields.doubt: O artigo apresenta o seu próprio sistema (Spec Kit Agents) como contribuição principal e depois avalia-o. Pela regra de 23/11 a natureza principal deve ser 'Proposes an approach' (o Q13 já foi pontuado como tal). Vê o resumo e as Contributions (pág. 1-2) e decide.

fields.v: Custom 32-task set (quality = LLM-judge composite 1-5; time = wall-clock on completed runs); authors' success criterion: PR produced + >=1 file modified + no critical execution error, but success/completion rates per configuration not reported; composite <3.0 only flags manual review. All runs Claude Code CLI 2.1.50 + MiniMax-M2.5. (1) Baseline (no SDD) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: quality 3.46; time 14.4 min (40-min budget). Quality and cost: no criterion stated by the authors (success rate not reported). (2) Augmented (no SDD + hooks) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.50; 15.5 min (40-min budget). No criterion stated by the authors. (3) Full (Spec Kit) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.51; 24.0 min (90-min budget). No criterion stated by the authors. (4) Full-Augmented (Spec Kit Agents) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 3.66; 37.2 min (90-min budget). No criterion stated by the authors. (5) Discovery-only (ablation): 3.53; 25.5 min. No criterion stated by the authors. (6) Validation-only (ablation): 3.57; 31.2 min. No criterion stated by the authors. Test compatibility 99.7-100% across configurations (per-config values not given). SWE-bench Lite (Pass@1): (7) Baseline + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 56.5%. (8) Augmented (hooks enabled) + Claude Code + MiniMax-M2.5: 58.2%. No criterion stated by the authors; cost not reported
fields.quote: Success criteria. A run is considered successful if it produces a pull request in the target repository, includes at least one file modification, and completes without critical execution errors (e.g., authentication failures or tool-permission violations).
fields.why: The verdicts (works/partly) are derived from differences against other configurations (e.g. '+0.04 vs Baseline', '+1.1 min'), not from a criterion stated by the authors applied to each configuration on its own; the authors' run-success criterion has no reported per-configuration rate.
fields.doubt: Os veredictos 'works/partly' foram dados comparando com outras configurações (ex.: +0,04 face ao Baseline), mas a regra exige julgar cada uma sozinha e só com critério dos autores. O critério de sucesso (PR + ficheiro + sem erro) existe, mas a taxa por configuração não é dada. Vê §3.4 (pág. 3) e decide se fica 'no criterion stated by the authors'.

fields.v: Full workflow (Full, Full-Augmented); Baseline/Augmented skip the spec artefacts. SWE-bench Lite: 'baseline configuration' and 'context-grounding hooks enabled' (presumably Baseline and Augmented, no spec artefacts; the text does not say explicitly)
fields.quote: Spec Kit Agents achieves a 56.5% pass rate in the baseline configuration and 58.2% with context-grounding hooks enabled.
fields.why: The text never states which workflow (direct or Spec Kit) the SWE-bench runs used, so 'only Baseline and Augmented (no spec artefacts)' is an inference.
fields.doubt: O texto só diz 'baseline configuration' e 'hooks enabled' para o SWE-bench; não diz se foi o fluxo direto ou o Spec Kit. A afirmação 'sem artefactos de especificação' é uma inferência. Vê §4.5 e Tabela 5 (pág. 4) e decide se a marcas como provável.
